SongComments.SongComment: This song shows how to use the Sample pitch commands:
0GXX will glide to the specified notes at the given speed instead of retriggering them.
0UXX/0DXX will slide the notes up or down.

For both commands, each 10 in the value corresponds to a semitone, so a 0U10 will raise the pitch of a C-4 note to C#4, while a 0G20 will glide down from C-4 to A#3 if the note to glide to is lower or equal to A#3, otherwise the glide will stop earlier.
